# MarkCoders

> Custom software, web, and mobile app development for startups, scaleups, and established brands.

MarkCoders builds digital products that stand out and convert - from UI/UX and web apps to APIs, CMS platforms, and branding.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.markcoders.com/): Studio overview and featured work
- [About](https://www.markcoders.com/about): Team, story, and how we work
- [Services](https://www.markcoders.com/services): Full service catalog
- [Portfolio](https://www.markcoders.com/portfolio): Selected projects and case studies
- [Case Studies](https://www.markcoders.com/case-studies): In-depth project write-ups

## Services

- [UI/UX Design](https://www.markcoders.com/services/ui-ux): Product design and user experience
- [Web Development](https://www.markcoders.com/services/web-development): Custom websites and web apps
- [App Development](https://www.markcoders.com/services/app-development): Mobile and cross-platform apps
- [API Integration](https://www.markcoders.com/services/api-integration): Systems and third-party APIs
- [CMS Development](https://www.markcoders.com/services/cms-development): Content platforms and admin tools
- [Graphic Design](https://www.markcoders.com/services/graphic-design): Brand and visual identity
